formulas.event_annual_revenue_growth_yoy: current annual revenue / prior annual revenue - 1; denominator positive
formulas.event_annual_profit_margin_change_yoy: current annual profit/revenue minus prior annual profit/revenue
formulas.event_annual_cfo_margin_change_yoy: current annual operating cash flow/revenue minus prior annual operating cash flow/revenue
formulas.event_annual_profit_change_to_assets: (current annual net income - prior annual net income) / current same-year-end Assets
formulas.event_annual_cfo_to_assets_change_yoy: current annual CFO/same-year-end Assets minus prior annual CFO/same-year-end Assets
formulas.event_balance_liabilities_ratio_change_y: latest liabilities/assets minus prior-year liabilities/assets; ratios matched within each accession/end
formulas.event_balance_equity_ratio_change_yoy: latest stockholders equity/assets minus prior-year stockholders equity/assets; ratios matched within each accession/end
formulas.event_sessions_since_new_balance: NYSE sessions since first usable session strictly after the filing that advanced the latest original balance-sheet period
formulas.event_sessions_since_new_annual: NYSE sessions since first usable session strictly after the original 10-K filing that advanced the latest annual period
formulas.event_new_balance_filed_5d: 1 when new balance-period event age is 0-4 sessions, otherwise 0 after coverage begins
formulas.event_new_balance_filed_20d: 1 when new balance-period event age is 0-19 sessions, otherwise 0 after coverage begins
formulas.event_new_annual_filed_5d: 1 when new annual-period event age is 0-4 sessions, otherwise 0 after coverage begins
formulas.event_new_annual_filed_20d: 1 when new annual-period event age is 0-19 sessions, otherwise 0 after coverage begins
formulas.event_financial_amendment_filed_20d: 1 if an eligible 10-K/A or 10-Q/A containing selected financial facts became usable in last 20 sessions; distinct from new-period events

scope: Only existing SEC snapshots; no labels, market returns, model fitting or 2026 prices read.
availability: filed < Date; NYSE session strictly after filed is event age 0
annual_match: Original or amended 10-K annual facts, 330-380 day durations; current/prior start and end gaps each 330-400 days; closest period-end gap to 365
ratio_match: Each period's facts must share accession and period end; annual flows additionally share start; Assets is instant at annual end in same accession
new_period_event: Only original 10-K/10-Q that strictly advances latest accepted report period; comparative-only re-reporting and /A never refresh period event clock
amendment_event: Separate 20-session indicator for 10-K/A or 10-Q/A containing accepted financial concepts; not all possible amendments
missing: All Date/symbol retained, numerical NaN plus explicit missing indicators; no imputation here
quarterly_scope: No quarterly income growth or YTD differencing; annual comparisons only, plus quarterly balance-sheet new-period events
